steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: AO1 assesses: technical control (accuracy, fluency, intonation), expression (dynamics, phrasing, articulation), and interpretation (stylistic understanding, communication). | Key Fact: Choose a piece that shows your STRENGTHS — difficulty alone does not guarantee marks if you cannot perform it accurately and expressively. | Key Fact: Practice strategies: slow practice, sectional rehearsal, recording and self-evaluation, gradual tempo increase, focused work on difficult passages. | Key Fact: Minimum duration is 1 minute per piece — but quality matters more than length. A well-performed shorter piece can score higher than a poorly performed long one.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe how solo performance are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary. | Compare how two different pieces use solo performance. Explain the effect in each case. | How could you use solo performance in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.
